sloka: माम् प्राप्य हि गुणो दोषः संवृत्तः पश्य लक्ष्मण ।अद्य एव सर्व भूतानाम् रक्षसाम् अभवाय च ॥३-६४-५६॥
transliteration: mām prāpya hi guṇo doṣaḥ saṁvṛttaḥ paśya lakṣmaṇa ।adya eva sarva bhūtānām rakṣasām abhavāya ca ॥3-64-56॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana even demerits turn into merits when they come in contact with me. Just as the Sun shines, effacing the moonlight, my brilliance will outshine my demerits of exterminating all (wicked) beings including the demons.
